components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Compact mechanical action for running the suite or copying code.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.55rem; border:1px solid var(--graphite); border-radius:0; padding:.65rem .85rem; color:var(--paper-raised); background:var(--graphite); font:800 .7rem/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary__mark { width:0; height:0; border-top:5px solid transparent; border-bottom:5px solid transparent; border-left:8px solid currentColor; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--ink); border-color:var(--ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:progress; opacity:.65; }

components.name: Family Tab
components.description: A ruled family selector that becomes plotting blue when selected.
components.css: .ds-family-tab { min-width:9rem; min-height:3.5rem; border:0; border-right:1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius:0; color:var(--graphite); background:transparent; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-strong); font:800 .75rem/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-family-tab:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-family-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color:var(--paper-raised); background:var(--ink); } .ds-family-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-family-tab:active { filter:brightness(.92); }

components.name: Proof Readout
components.description: A ruled metric pairing a compact equipment label with a tabular result.
components.css: .ds-proof-readout { display:flex; min-height:5.5rem; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:.12rem; padding:0 1rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); color:var(--graphite); background:var(--paper); } .ds-proof-readout span { color:var(--graphite-muted); font:.7rem/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-proof-readout strong { color:#424542; font:400 clamp(.85rem, 1.65vw, 1.75rem)/1 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-proof-readout:hover strong { color:var(--ink); } .ds-proof-readout:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Ruled Data Table
components.description: Dense evidence table with tabular figures and one-pixel row rules.
components.css: .ds-proof-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:var(--graphite-muted); background:var(--paper); font:400 .75rem/1.45 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-proof-table caption { padding:0 0 .45rem; font:800 .75rem/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.08em; text-align:left; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-proof-table th, .ds-proof-table td { padding:.32rem .2rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); text-align:left; } .ds-proof-table th:last-child, .ds-proof-table td:last-child { text-align:right; } .ds-proof-table tbody tr:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-proof-table:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Plot Legend
components.description: An unboxed key that distinguishes primary, secondary, and robust traces.
components.html:
OLS liney = 2.492x − 1.000
Poly (deg 2)r² = 0.987
Robust liney = 2.492x − 1.000
components.css: .ds-plot-legend { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.65rem; padding:.65rem; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper); font:400 .75rem/1.35 var(--sans); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-plot-legend>div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2rem 6rem 1fr; gap:.35rem; align-items:center; } .ds-plot-legend code { color:var(--ink); font:400 .75rem/1.35 var(--mono); text-transform:none; } .ds-key { display:block; height:2px; background:var(--ink); } .ds-key--poly { background:var(--ink-light); } .ds-key--robust { height:1px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--graphite) 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px); } .ds-plot-legend:hover { color:var(--graphite); } .ds-plot-legend:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
regressio feels like a calibrated technical sheet caught midway through a proof run: cool paper, exact graphite rulings, measured readouts, and a saturated blue pen trace. Information stays exposed and continuous. The visual hierarchy comes from scale, alignment, and ruled partitions instead of a collection of floating dashboard cards.

The system is dense but calm. Large condensed headlines establish the claim, monospaced measurements make evidence scannable, and the realistic plotter carriage gives the otherwise flat world one physical signature. Every expressive move should help a developer see the suite pass, follow the trace, or inspect the underlying results.
keyCharacteristics: Cool drafting-paper ground with graphite structure.
Saturated plotting blue for active traces, selections, and positive proof emphasis.
Safety orange reserved for failures and the keyboard focus ring.
Condensed sans-serif hierarchy paired with tabular monospaced evidence.
Registration marks, calibration ticks, ruled tabs, and plots without card shells.
A single plotter carriage supplies the system's realistic material accent.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Plotting blue carries the active trace and current selection; keep it scarce enough that the live result remains the clearest blue object.

rules.name: The Safety Exception Rule
rules.body: Safety orange appears only when the interface requires immediate attention: a failed proof or a visible keyboard focus target.

rules.name: The Continuous Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with graphite rules and alignment before introducing another surface color.

rules.name: The Measured Evidence Rule
rules.body: Numbers, equations, timings, and runtime states use the monospaced readout face with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Condensed Claim Rule
rules.body: Large statements use a tight condensed display; do not expand them into wide, soft marketing typography.

rules.name: The Dominant Plot Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, reserve roughly four-fifths of the proof sheet for the drawing field and one-fifth for vertically aligned evidence.

rules.name: The Stack Without Cards Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts preserve ruled continuity by stacking the same regions and borders; they do not turn those regions into detached cards.

rules.name: The One Physical Object Rule
rules.body: Realistic depth belongs to the plotter carriage; all interface surfaces remain flat and ruled.

rules.name: The Instrument Geometry Rule
rules.body: Use straight edges for information and circles for instrument state or calibration details.

dos: Do keep evidence visible: pair claims with live values, equations, timings, or status.
Do use one-pixel graphite rules to create hierarchy across continuous paper.
Do reserve plotting blue for the active trace, selected controls, and explicit proof emphasis.
Do use monospaced tabular figures for measurements and results.
Do preserve keyboard focus visibility and reduced-motion behavior.
Do let the plotter carriage be the one realistic, shadowed signature.
donts: Don't break proof surfaces into rounded, floating dashboard cards.
Don't add decorative shadows to tabs, tables, buttons, or proof blocks.
Don't use safety orange as a general accent or decorative highlight.
Don't crowd the sheet with multiple realistic machines or competing hero objects.
Don't replace ruled structure with soft containers, gradients, or ornamental chrome.
